people.name: Turegaliev Nariman
people.workScopeZh: 官方页面未列出单独工作范围。
people.generalInfoHtml:
Nariman Turegaliev – born in 1964, higher education, graduated from Zhambyl Hydro-Reclamation and Construction Institute in 1990 with a degree in "Engineer-economist", in 2004 - · Caspian Public University with a degree in "Lawyer".

Date of appointment: 02.12.2022
people.careerHistoryHtml:
CAREER

  • Economist, Chief economist of the Agricultural Association named after the "XVII Party Congress" (1990-1995);
  • Chief Accountant, Chief Economist, supplier of the Aitievo production complex (1997-1999);
  • Head of the farm "Akzhol" (1999-2001);
  • Head of the Department of Labor and Social Protection of the population of the Terektinsky district of the West Kazakhstan region (2001-2002);
  • Director of a general type boarding school, Uralsk (2002-2003);
  • Deputy Head of the Department of Employment and Social Protection of the Population of the West Kazakhstan region (2003-2005);
  • Deputy Director of the Department of Coordination of Employment and Social Programs of the West Kazakhstan region (2005-2008);
  • Director of the Department of the Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan for Regulation of Natural Monopolies in the West Kazakhstan region (2008-2010);
  • Head of the Department of Employment and Social Programs of the West Kazakhstan region (2010-2012);
  • Akim of Akzhaiksky district of West Kazakhstan region (2012-2015);
  • Deputy Akim of West Kazakhstan region (2015-2016);
  • Akim of the city of Uralsk (2016-2017);

Elected positions, deputations:

  • Deputy of the Senate of the Parliament of the Republic of Kazakhstan (since 06.2017);
  • Secretary of the Committee on Socio-Cultural Development and Science (09.2020-06.2022);
  • Chairman of the Committee on Socio-Cultural Development and Science (06.2022-12.2022).

 

State and international awards, prizes, honorary titles:

Order of "Kurmet" (2016)

people.generalInfoHtml: Aitmukhambetov Kaliyar Shadiyarovich - born in 1969. Education – higher. He graduated from the West Kazakhstan Agricultural University and the West Kazakhstan Engineering and Humanities University with a degree in agronomy and law.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
He began his career in 1986 as a worker of the state farm "Kyzylkulsky" of the Chingirlau district.

In different years he worked:
- Deputy director for youth work of the state farm "Kyzylkulsky", agronomist of department No. 2 Shoktybai Chingirlau district;
- Chief specialist of the Department of Internal Policy and Social Sphere of the akim's office of Chingirlau district;
- Head of the Department of Employment and Social protection of the population of Chingirlau district;
- head of the akim's office, deputy akim of Chingirlau district;
- Head of the Department of Coordination of employment and social programs of the West Kazakhstan region.

Until today, he worked as the akim of the Akzhaiksky district of the West Kazakhstan region.

Aitmukhambetov Kaliar Shaidiyarovich will oversee issues of energy and housing and communal services, entrepreneurship and industrial and innovative development, agriculture, land relations, natural resources and environmental management regulation, veterinary medicine.

people.generalInfoHtml:
In coordination with the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the order of the Akim of the West Kazakhstan region, Kayupov Tlepbergen Ersaevich was appointed deputy akim of the region.
Kayupov Tlepbergen Ersaevich - born in 1976. Education – higher. He graduated from the West Kazakhstan Agricultural University with a degree in accountant-financier.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
In different years he worked:
-Tax inspector of the Tax Committee for Kaztalovsky district, head of the Department of Economics and Finance of Kaztalovsky district;
- Head of the Department, Deputy Head of the Finance Department of the West Kazakhstan region;
- Deputy Akim of Chingirlau district;
- Deputy Head of the Construction Department of the West Kazakhstan region;
- Head of the Department of Economics and Budget Planning of the West Kazakhstan region;
- Deputy Akim of the West Kazakhstan region;
Until today, he worked as the head of the Finance Department of the West Kazakhstan region.
Tlepbergen Kayupov will oversee issues of strategy and economic development, finance, public procurement and communal property, coordination of employment and social programs, labor inspection, construction, state architectural and construction control and passenger transport, and highways.

people.generalInfoHtml:
Батыс Қазақстан облысының әкімі Нариман Төреғалиевтің өкімімен Қазақстан Республикасы Президентінің Әкімшілігімен келісе отырып, Батыс Қазақстан облысы әкімінің орынбасары лауазымына Қайыржан Меңдіғалиев тағайындалды.

Өңір басшысы өзінің жаңа орынбасарын таныстырып, Қайыржан Ермекұлына жұмысына табыс пен сәттілік тілеп, оның алдында тұрған бірқатар міндеттерді де тілге тиек етті.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
БҚО әкімінің орынбасары лауазымына тағайындалғанға дейін Алматы қаласы жастар саясаты басқармасының басшысы қызметін атқарған.

Бұған дейін Халықаралық білім беру корпорациясының (ҚазБСҚА) бірінші проректоры, М.Тынышпаев атындағы Қазақ көлік және коммуникациялар академиясының тәрбие жұмысы және маркетинг жөніндегі проректоры лауазымдарын атқарған, оқытушы, кейін Халықаралық бизнес университетінде (UIB) проректор болып жұмыс істеген.

Әл-Фараби атындағы Қазақ ұлттық университетінің “Инновациялық менеджмент” мамандығы бойынша бакалавриат және магистратураны бітірген.
Үйленген, үш баласы бар.

people.name: Oraz Nurdilda Serikuly
people.positionZh: 西哈萨克斯坦州州长办公室主任
people.workScopeZh: 数字化
people.generalInfoHtml:
Oraz Nurdilda Serikuly was appointed the head of the office of the Akim of the West Kazakhstan region in coordination with the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Oraz Nurdilda Serikuly was born in 1981.Higher education. He graduated from Al-Farabi Kazakh National University with a degree in Journalism and the Karaganda Academy of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan named after Barimbek Beisenov with a degree in Law Enforcement.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
He started his career in 2003 as a correspondent-presenter of the Kazakh edition of the news program "Informburo" of "Channel 31" LLP.

In different years he worked in a number of republican TV channels. In 2009, he joined the internal affairs bodies, worked as the head of the Department of Language Policy and Information of the Department of Internal Affairs of Astana, Director of the Department of State Language and Information of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan - the press secretary of the Minister, and then the official representative of the Ministry. In 2016, he worked as Deputy Head of the Office of the Prosecutor General of the Republic of Kazakhstan. 2019-2022. he was an adviser to the Minister of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Prior to his appointment, he held the position of Head of the Public Development Department of the West Kazakhstan region.
